title: hibiscus lunariifolius var. dongolensis
intro: Hibiscus lunariifolius var. dongolensis, commonly known as Dongolza, is a variant of the hibiscus plant species. It is a plant used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Dongolza are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Dongolza include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
